games.notes: Controlled tune-up with strong right-side combinations.
Fast starts behind the Dutch high line decided the match.
Defensive shape held late pressure after conceding from a set piece.
Midfield duel improved after switching Camavinga higher.
Prepare wide overload defense and second-ball cover.
Rehearse regain-to-through-ball actions and penalty routine.

announcements.title: Portugal quarter-final preview
announcements.content: Portugal are expected to overload the left half-space. Training emphasis this week is compact rest defense, early switches to Dembele, and Mbappe runs between fullback and center-back.
announcements.author: Didier Deschamps

announcements.title: Recovery and sprint exposure block
announcements.content: Starters complete pool recovery and mobility before a short acceleration exposure. Substitutes have a 45-minute high-intensity technical session.
announcements.author: Claire Moreau

announcements.title: Family visit window confirmed
announcements.content: Family access is open after lunch on Friday. Players must return to the team hotel before the tactical briefing.
announcements.author: Team Operations

announcements.title: Load management note
announcements.content: Griezmann and Rabiot are on reduced external load until the final matchday-minus-two session. Medical review after each field session.
announcements.author: Performance Staff

tactics.customPlaystyle: Explosive transition with controlled possession spells
tactics.customDefensiveStyle: Compact mid-block with sprint press triggers
tactics.customStrategyNotes: Draw Portugal forward, protect the center with Tchouameni, then release Mbappe and Dembele into the channels after regains.

notes.title: Portugal press trigger
notes.content: Press aggressively only on backwards passes into their left center-back. Otherwise hold a compact 4-4-2 shell.

notes.title: Near-post decoy
notes.content: Upamecano attacks near-post lane as decoy; Saliba delays to the penalty spot for second contact.
